_column_contract: Summit's cover box runs Current | Last(=Previous, 2024 sheet) | Cumulative — the REVERSE of the parsed cities' sheet. All three columns are captured VERBATIM and LABELLED here; the builder promotes one per the rule documented in CLAUDE.md. "" = the cell was EMPTY (or a slashed-zero / dash nil mark) on the form; null = a value is present but ILLEGIBLE and was never guessed.

_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: exact, and with NO structural residual: like his pre-election filing (1082) this filer itemized BOTH halves of the split50 sheet - 15 rows reproducing the $4,180.00 '>$50' box on p4 and 18 rows reproducing the $280.00 '<=$50' box on the separate sheet he hand-headed '$50.00 & less' on p5. 4,180.00 + 280.00 = 4,460.00 = the stated total. The 33 rows are the SAME 33 donors, in the same order, with the same dates and amounts as 1082 - this is a re-filed photocopy of the pre-election ledger, which the cover corroborates by printing identical contribution figures in all three columns (Current = Last = Cumulative). That makes the two filings an INDEPENDENT SECOND READ of the same page rather than new data: every row was re-transcribed from this copy and matched the 1082 transcription cell for cell. GRAIN: unambiguously cumulative, no ruling needed. Specimen row 'Jon and Jane Doe $435.00' dropped from both sheets. No in-kind schedule exists.

expenditures.detail: DELTA of exactly $40.00 - the SAME $40.00 as the pre-election filing, and this is the strongest possible evidence that it is FILER ARITHMETIC and not a misread. p2 reproduces 1082's expense sheet row for row; its 34 rows sum to 3,691.09 against the boxed 3,651.09, just as they did on 1082 p8. p3 adds two clean new rows, 275.00 + 1,903.84 = 2,178.84, which close exactly on the cover's Last Report cell. 3,691.09 + 2,178.84 = 5,869.93 against the printed cumulative 5,829.93. The error therefore PROPAGATES: the filer carried his own wrong page-1 total into his cumulative and into his balance (4,460.00 - 5,829.93 = -1,369.93, exactly the printed negative campaign balance). Two independent scans of the same page, read on two separate occasions in this wave, produce the same 34 amounts and the same 3,691.09 - a transcription error would not reproduce. Retained as filed, never repaired. Specimen row 'Name of Business / Campaign signs and flyers / $512.00' dropped from both sheets.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: PAGE POSITION IS NOT A CLASSIFIER HERE EITHER: the two EXPENSE sheets come FIRST (p2, p3) and the two CONTRIBUTION sheets last (p4, p5). The filer hand-numbered the expense sheets 'page 1' and 'page 2' in the top-right corner, which is the only thing on the document that says how the two are meant to combine. p2 prints 'Total amount of expenditures $3,651.09' - the PRE-ELECTION figure - and repeats that filing's 34 rows verbatim; p3 prints '$5,829.93', the CUMULATIVE figure, over only the TWO new post-election rows (re-read at 900 dpi: 275.00 and 1,903.84, summing to 2,178.84). So p3's box is NOT that page's own row sum, and a page-local gate would fail on it; the correct gate is 3,651.09 + 2,178.84 = 5,829.93, which is exactly the cover's Cumulative Totals cell. CONTRIBUTION GATE: p4 and p5 both print the same pair of boxes, '>$50 $4,180.00' and '<=$50 $280.00'; p4's 15 rows sum to 4,180.00 and p5's 18 rows to 280.00, and 4,180.00 + 280.00 = 4,460.00 = the module's stated total and the cover's Cumulative cell. The cover confirms nothing new was raised after the pre-election report: contributions carry the SAME figures in all three columns. The printed SPECIMEN row appears on all four sheets and is dropped from all four; every box closes only without it.

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: Kris (Krisden Boyington) Hendricksen, County Sheriff, 2014 POST-Election - the sibling of 1082 and the cover-differencing gate for it. Five pages, four of them ledgers, no blank versos this time. WHAT THIS PAIR ESTABLISHES: (1) A POST-ELECTION FILING CAN BE THE PRE-ELECTION LEDGER PLUS ONE PAGE. Three of the four ledger sheets here are re-filed photocopies of 1082's; only p3 is new, and it carries two rows. The re-filed sheets keep their ORIGINAL boxed totals (p2 still says $3,651.09) while the NEW sheet's box carries the CUMULATIVE. Anyone gating page-by-page will wrongly fail p3; anyone summing the two filings will double-count 3,691.09 of expenditures and all 4,460.00 of contributions. The module's standing rule - Summit reports are cumulative snapshots, never summed across filings - is exactly right here. (2) THE $40 EXPENSE DELTA REPRODUCES ACROSS TWO INDEPENDENT SCANS AND TWO SEPARATE READS. That converts it from 'a delta this wave could not close' into a positively established fact about the filer's arithmetic. (3) The <=$50 ITEMIZATION IS DELIBERATE AND HABITUAL, not a one-off: the same filer used a second hand-headed contribution sheet in both of his 2014 filings. PRIVACY: full mailing addresses and zip codes are printed on p4/p5 and were discarded at read time; only donor_city and donor_state are stored, read from the address cell and never inferred from a zip. 'Pl. Grove' and 'Am fork' are expanded to Pleasant Grove and American Fork; all other cities are as written. Nothing on this filing is redacted. The county's copy carries the same orange/pink highlighter ticks in the right margin of the '$50.00 & less' sheet (p5) that appear on 1082 p7 - reader's check-off marks, not data. GEOMETRY: all 69 rows use DECLARED frames (force_declared), one per side, each fitted to the pages' own printed rules measured on the RAW page in a narrow x-slice (which removes the skew the deskewing detector introduces) and then probe-verified by crop. Contributions x=8.4 y0=22.476 pitch=1.928 w=83.0, verified at p4 band 2 (Cunningham 150.00), p4 band 16 (Welker 200.00), p5 band 2 (Lee Wilson 10.00) and p5 band 19 (Kaylee Hendricksen 20.00). Expenditures x=8.4 y0=16.303 pitch=1.9212 w=82.9, verified at p2 band 2 (Summit County 605.00), p2 band 35 (Park Record 499.00), p3 band 1 (Summit County News 275.00) and p3 band 2 (Park Record 1,903.84). NOTE THE TWO PAGE-PHASE FACTS, because they are a source property and not a defect: p4 and p5 are out of phase by 0.53% of page height (0.27 of a row) and p2 and p3 by 1.45% (0.75 of a row) - the same printed form lands at different heights on different scans - so the SHARED per-side frame is a compromise. On contributions the residual is at most 0.27% (14% of a row) and invisible; on expenditures p3's two rows sit 0.48% low against the frame and take bands 1 and 2 rather than 2 and 3, which was chosen by crop rather than by arithmetic. Where the shaded HEADER and SPECIMEN rows are dark (p2 and p4) the rule detector reports a spurious rule inside the shading; those grids were fitted to the unshaded rules below and extrapolated upward, never anchored on the first detected band.
